Data-center ESA conversion - now a TWO-STAGE hinge: whether the 15.4GW late-stage pipeline actually converts to signed ESAs by 1H-2027 as promised, after a quarter in which executed GW rose only 7.6 -> 7.8 (+0.2GW vs +2.7GW the prior quarter) on "very complicated" negotiations; and (b) whether the 7.8GW already executed energizes into billed load from 2H-2027/2028 on schedule - since that single variable underwrites the $103B plan (plus the flagged $5-10B upside), the "top-half 6-7%" acceleration from 2028, AND the FFO/debt path to 15% that still leans on DEF minority-stake proceeds.
